evidence.value: Éclairage UVB recommandé de faible intensité.
evidence.quote: ReptiFiles recommends UVB lighting for all reptiles, including crested geckos. Since cresties are crepuscular and typically hide behind leaves during the day, they are classified under Ferguson Zone 1, which means you don’t need anything particularly strong.

evidence.value: Espèce arboricole : privilégier un terrarium haut avec des branches et des surfaces à explorer verticalement et horizontalement.
evidence.quote: As you choose an enclosure for your gecko, keep in mind that since cresties are arboreal, height is better than width or depth. That being said, too narrow of an enclosure isn’t a good thing, either. Crested geckos don’t just travel vertically — they also travel horizontally as they thermoregulate, photoregulate, and generally explore.

evidence.value: Espèce arboricole : privilégier un terrarium haut avec des branches et des surfaces à explorer verticalement et horizontalement.
evidence.quote: It is able to jump long distances between branches to move to new locations.
